author: Anish9879876
title: Toll Free Response
review_text: 0 responsiveness. The only automation they have while calling is the system operator who asks to wait in the queue. Once the turn is finally there after waiting for such long duration, there’s no real person to talk to who speaks and resolves the issue. It’s basically a blank system. From such a big giant company, this is something intolerant. I have faced this issue not only once but multiple times. It is understandable sometimes, however they are consistent in non improvising the service.

author: angelaa_19
title: Left me stranded for hours during a transaction
review_text: Constantly crashes and throws service errors right when you try to transfer money to a vendor. I spent hours waiting for the app to work just to complete a basic payment, which created a huge mess for me and the merchant. Completely lost trust in this app… Very disappointed
